title: NIST WebBook: Nitrogen dioxide is NO2, molecular weight 46.0055 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Nitrogen dioxide as NO2, molecular weight 46.0055 amu, CAS 10102-44-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Nitrogen dioxide, CAS Registry Number 10102-44-0, lists molecular formula NO2 and molecular weight 46.0055 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 45.9929032439 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/NO2/c2-1-3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
